prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: image 1, the CYMBA studio product photograph. Image 2 is the same locked product design for geometry verification.
Change ONLY framing and arrangement to create a wider, airy complete-system hero. Keep exact hardware geometry, scale relationships, materials, soft neutral studio surface and beautiful soft lighting.
Pull camera back by 25 percent. Arrange both earbuds in the upper central half; left outer view, right inner view. Keep their exact faceplates, plain fins, body contacts, tip insets and bottom cable exits. Controller sits diagonally across lower centre and USB-C connector sits at lower right. Ensure the ENTIRE USB-C plug including metal end has at least 10 percent clear margin from the right edge. Each earbud and controller also fully inside bounds with breathing room. Cables form relaxed deliberate arcs below buds and join plausibly before the controller; preserve a realistic continuous wired system, no severed or unconnected wires. Show the pair's cable joining section if possible; cable can extend beyond bottom only if physically needed but no hardware clipped. All objects smaller in frame than image 1, more surrounding seamless grey negative space. This must be visibly a more spacious composition, not a pixel-identical copy of image 1.
Landscape 4:3. Photorealistic premium product photography, very fine detail, no text, logo, labels, hands, people, additional components, extra USB ends or decorative effects. Do not redesign, recolour or rotate the product into a different architecture.

initialGeneration.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: CYMBA premium wired earbud website hero; one individual photograph, landscape 4:3, high native detail.
Input image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE LOCKED PRODUCT DESIGN, determining exact geometry, parts and cable routing. Input image 2 is supporting finish/clarity reference only.
Create a new refined editorial studio photograph of this SAME COMPLETE PRODUCT: two compact earbuds, their braided cables, three-button inline controller and USB-C connector, arranged elegantly on a seamless cool very-light-grey matte surface. The near earbud shows its subtly oval satin black outer faceplate and thin champagne bezel; the farther earbud shows its inner contact panel and soft grey tip. Give each object breathing room; cable curves are deliberate and physically continuous, joining plausibly into the controller. The complete system must be legible and fit fully inside the image, with about 10 percent safe margin. Camera elevated three-quarter angle with mild telephoto perspective, soft large light from upper left, realistic soft contact shadows, tactile fine detail, clean background. A balanced editorial composition, product occupies about 70 percent of the frame.
LOCKED HARDWARE: compact organically sculpted smoked translucent charcoal shell; slightly oval softly domed finely textured satin-black outer faceplate, thin pale champagne perimeter rim, NO radial brushed circular disc. Soft curved BLACK stabilization fin is completely plain black: no contacts on fin. The EAR-FACING INNER BODY below the fin has two vertically arranged pale champagne oval contact pads next to one separate small recessed vertical rectangular optical window, exactly as input 1. One short dark acoustic nozzle with one replaceable soft smoke-grey tip and single dark sound bore. Narrow champagne tip insets follow input 1. Fine braided black cables exit the BOTTOM through short downward strain reliefs. Slim charcoal inline controller with minus, central, plus buttons and tiny white indicator, USB-C at the end. Keep all dimensions and relationships faithful to input 1.
Palette: soft cool grey, charcoal, muted champagne. Premium tangible hardware, natural restrained reflections, dimensional but not plasticky.
No human, hand, text, logo, watermark, invented markings, panels, annotations, charging case, wireless hardware, top cable exit, over-ear loop, extra earbuds, extra sensors, duplicated connectors, sci-fi glow or splash effects. No exaggerated giant ear tips.

qa: Inspected: whole system within frame, matching locked geometry, a visible cable join, plain fins, inner contacts, downward cable exits, three-button controller and one USB-C plug. Targeted second pass improved spacing and removed edge clipping.
